Egg Timer

Boil the perfect egg — soft (6 min), medium (8 min) and hard (10 min) presets plus a custom timer with alarm.

0:00

Times assume eggs go into already-boiling water.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick soft, medium or hard — or set a custom time.
  2. Lower your eggs into boiling water and press Start.
  3. Wait for the alarm when the countdown ends.
  4. Cool the eggs in ice water and peel.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What times does it use?

Soft 6 minutes (runny yolk), medium 8 minutes (jammy yolk), hard 10 minutes (fully set). Times assume large eggs lowered into already-boiling water.

Can I set a custom time?

Yes — enter any custom time from 1 to 60 minutes.

How do I stop the eggs overcooking?

Move the eggs to ice water immediately for 5 minutes — this stops the cooking and makes peeling easier.
